title: ID0419524-DC/Si-D/EE-[Bk40RC]-After backend change AC lifetime energy starts from 0
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
After backend change AC lifetime energy starts from 0
Solution:
Charger has no AC Bauer Meter. In FW 6.1.3 is a virtual meter implemented that accumulate the energy consuption at this outlet. It is used as Meter Value in StartTransaction and StopTransaction.
The virtual Meter is set to 0 when the charger is restarted and then increased by every charging session.
Child ticket created#0420692

additional_info.subject: Note from RC
additional_info.body:
Location:
Charger backend provider was changed and after change was done, AC
Energy.Active.Import.Register started from 0 when physical display shows lifetime consumption around 2700kWh. Why lifetime consumption is not visible in Energy.Active.Import.Register? Software feature, bug or what?
Message from customer:
I noticed that the first time CP sent it's MeterValues for each connector the #1 and #3 values for Energy.Active.Import.Register matched what their physical meters were displaying but #2 reported
Energy.Active.Import.Register value as 0 (meter display was showing around 2700kWh). Later when testing the AC charging the StartTransaction also reported meterStart=0 on first transaction and on later transactions the meterStart value matched what the last transaction ended at so it was not a transaction based reading but cumulative value.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419524-DC/Si-D/EE-[Bk40RC]-After backend change AC lifetime energy starts from 0 CRM:00921001678
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
Hope you are doing well.
The Charger has no AC Bauer Meter. In FW 6.1.3 is a virtual meter implemented that accumulate the energy consumption at this outlet. It is used as Meter Value in StartTransaction and StopTransaction.
The virtual Meter is set to 0 when the charger is restarted and then increased by every charging session.
If this answers your query, shall we move ahead and close this ticket?
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
